svg.title: Plugins in the km-plugin-registry marketplace, grouped by type
svg.desc: Five skill and agent plugins: frontend-scaffold, feature-dev-documentalist, gitbook-docs-validator, implementation-spec and rigorous-review. Three mods: plan-progress, session-cost and prompt-coach. One hooks plugin: memors-hooks. Each plugin links to its description.
svg.text: you ask, Claude follows a packaged workflow

a.title: feature-dev-documentalist: open the description
a.text: A document for each phase of a feature,
written from what changed in git.

a.title: implementation-spec: open the description
a.text: A build-ready specification for a feature

a.title: rigorous-review: open the description
a.text: A strict pre-merge review of a diff, branch or PR: bugs, security, performance, over-engineering.
